title: Purple Lichen
description: Blue lichen to purple lichen for better difference from diamond.
body:
# description
This mod changes the glow of lichen from blue to purple so it can no longer be mistaken for diamonds in caves. This mod improves the visibility of lichen and helps distinguish it from diamonds and other ores.
